title: Gas grill, parts formed in China, enamelled and assembled in Indonesia
description: A 2- or 3-burner gas grill. Lids, fireboxes, burners and frames are formed in China, then enamelled and assembled in Indonesia. CBP held China (N335085, scenario 1); with the lids and fireboxes formed in Indonesia, the same ruling held Indonesia (scenario 2).
notes: One of the 10 product families added in D138 (gas grills and cooking appliances). The prediction and the plan search use the structured product built from CBP's scenario 1 facts. Precedents are limited to rulings dated before 1 Sep 2023, and N335085 itself is excluded. Duty rates, import value and group costs are illustrative placeholders, not sourced. A development check through an OpenAI-compatible LiteLLM gateway to Gemini (eval/results/families-plan-gas-grill-2023-litellm.json, one run) predicted China at 0.95 and showed one plan: lid and firebox forming, burners and gas train, and cooking surface, panels and frame in Indonesia, check 0.96 on N333420. It moves more than CBP's scenario 2 did. A run on this site is a new run and may differ.

product.name: Gas grills (2-burner and 3-burner models)
product.description: 2-burner and 3-burner gas grills consisting of a main lid, firebox, gas train assembly, control panel, cooking area, side shelf, cart frame, thermometer, and burners. In Scenario 1, components and sub-assemblies are formed and fabricated in China and shipped to Indonesia for porcelain enamel finishing, sub-assembly completion, final assembly, testing, and packaging.

components.name: Manifold tube, regulator hose, fittings, and gas valves
Perforated tube steel, fuel mixer screw, spider mesh, and burner cap

operations.name: Forming, punching, and prepping steel sheets for deep draw into main lids
Forming and punching steel sheets into fireboxes
Adding gas valve port holes, bending manifold to shape, adding threaded connectors, assembling gas valves onto manifold, and conducting gas tightness test
Cutting perforated tube steel, pressing and sealing ends to create a venturi funnel, adding a fuel mixer screw, punching a breather hole, and welding spider mesh and cap to make burners
Manufacturing control panels, cart frames, side shelves, and cooking area
Degreasing, pickling, rinsing, kiln drying, spraying porcelain enamel wet frit, furnace baking at 1,600 F for 25 minutes, and inspecting main lids and fireboxes
Assembling gas manifold onto LP regulator sub-assembly and fire testing completed gas train assemblies
Affixing lid handle, badges, and thermometer to complete the main lids
Installing burners into fireboxes and fire testing completed firebox sub-assemblies
Installing control panel, knobs, and gas train assembly onto fireboxes and testing for gas tightness, proper ignition, and combustion
Attaching remaining components with screws, bolts, and nuts, installing labels, cleaning surfaces, and packaging into retail boxes

economics.duty_rates_note: Illustrative placeholder, not a sourced rate.

actual_change._source: CBP ruling N335085 (14 Sep 2023), scenario 2: lids and fireboxes formed in Indonesia from Chinese sheet steel; CBP held Indonesia
